Hi Alex — quick technical answers to the items you raised. Quoting your questions inline where useful.

> Network egress: we need clarity on any outbound connections from an on-prem deployment (e.g., telemetry, health checks). Our default posture is egress-deny unless explicitly approved.

- For the air-gapped variant we discussed, there is zero outbound egress by default. Telemetry/metrics are buffered locally and can be exported via customer-controlled jump-hosts. For VPC/peered deployments we do maintain a control plane tunnel for control messages only (mutual TLS). If you require fully offline operation, we can provide an air-gapped installer bundle; lifecycle operations are then handled via signed operator bundles.

> Key management: our security team prefers a model where customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) can be used for at-rest encryption; can you confirm that is supported?

- Yes — customer-managed keys are supported. For cloud-hosted private deployments we integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault). For on-prem air-gapped installs we support HSMs (PKCS#11) and an option to load keys via secure import procedures. Key separation: model and encryption scopes (model weights vs. KV cache vs. logs) are configurable per-deployment.

> Audit logs: do you support separate audit log buckets per customer and the ability to hold logs for 7 years?

- We support per-customer log sinks and can configure retention policies up to multi-year. Note: long-term retention for high-volume token logs has cost implications; we typically recommend sampled token logs + full audit trails for config/ACL events.

Attached is a short ASCII network sketch and the diagram we referenced in the call.

--- network sketch (simplified) ---
[Redwood runtime] --(private peering)-- [Customer VPC - private subnet]
                     |
                     +--(optional egress jump-host)--> [Customer DMZ / Outbound proxy]

Air-gapped option:
- Installer bundle (signed) loaded into isolated environment
- Offline health checks, local operator console
- Optional ephemeral export via physically mediated media/VM

Let me know if you want me to annotate the diagram for specific firewall rules / port lists prior to Thu.
